content: Every man I meet is my master in some point, and in that I learn of him.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Every single human being possesses some unique skill, hard-won experience, or perspective that surpasses your own. Treating all people as teachers yields boundless wisdom.
practicalInsight: Ask questions and genuinely learn something from someone from a different background today.
reflectionPrompt: What unique wisdom can you learn from someone you might otherwise overlook?
